items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Tommy and I did two together. Those were a pleasure.

ctx.x: The band was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Flip Phillips, Prez.
Yeah, Tommy was on that. Was Charlie Shavers on that?
No, it was Eldridge, Tommy Turk, Parker, Phillips, Hank Jones, Ray Brown and Buddy Rich.
